note: Visible tests use round values; hidden tests cover half-up rounding, the roll-over to the next unit after rounding, negatives and the strict parser.

twin_breaks.rule: an exact half rounds away from zero
When rounding gives `1024.0`, the next unit is used
A negative count is formatted as its absolute value with a leading `-`
A `bool` or a value that is not an `int` raises `TypeError`
The text is a number, optional spaces, and a unit
The number is digits with an optional fraction of one or more digits, and an optional leading `-`
The result is the exact number of bytes when that is a whole number, and `ValueError` when it is not
